name: Easier Waypoints
summary: See the lane and its direction before placing a waypoint, for every line type.
description:
One road. One direction. No guesswork.

Easier Waypoints shows where a waypoint will go before you place it. It highlights the lane under the cursor, draws the direction of travel, and names the stretch of the line you are editing. The game's own Line Manager still saves every change.

HOW TO USE
Select a line in the Line Manager, then the stretch you want to edit. Press Place Waypoint, point at the lane the vehicles should use and click. Each click adds the next waypoint in order; press Back to finish. The other side of a road runs the other way, so move the cursor across to change direction. Ships and aircraft get a marker instead of a lane. You can still hold the precision-mode key and click, as in the base game; the tooltips now say so.

LIMITS
This is an experimental build that has not yet been verified in-game. Arrows only appear when the road's own lane data confirms the direction. Tracks are shown as usable both ways, because the route decides. The full route is not predicted; route problems appear in the stop list after placing. Other mods that replace the same placement tooltips or stop panel may conflict.

CHANGES

v0.2.0 — Experimental placement tool for every line type
Place Waypoint button with a lane and direction preview for road, tram, rail, ship and air lines. Arrows only when lane data confirms the direction. The correct stretch is shown when no stretch is selected. Tooltips explain the precision-mode key. Clearer stop panel guidance in the game's style. Says so when a preview can't be drawn. No custom save data.

v0.1.0 — Experimental direction preview
Candidate road lane highlight, directional chevrons, clearer placement guidance and selected-segment context. No simulation commands or custom save data.
